breve: A horizontal scrollbar that goes from left (min) to right (max).
descricao: A horizontal scrollbar, typically used to navigate through content that extends beyond the visible width of a control. It is a Range-based control and goes from left (min) to right (max).

itens_tema.desc:
Padding between the bottom of the 'ScrollBar.scroll' element and the 'ScrollBar.grabber'.
Note: To apply horizontal padding, modify the left/right content margins of 'ScrollBar.scroll' instead.

Padding between the top of the 'ScrollBar.scroll' element and the 'ScrollBar.grabber'.
Note: To apply horizontal padding, modify the left/right content margins of 'ScrollBar.scroll' instead.
